$comment: Independent adversarial review record for the v1.1 iteration (machine-readable product system). Three non-author review agents examined the full diff, attacked the gates, and re-verified every fix. Early terminations are disclosed, not hidden.
iteration: v1.1 machine-readable product system + 46-pattern interface anti-pattern catalog

mustFixFindings: Architecture scan fail-open: multi-line imports + devDependencies invisible (CRITICAL, verified with synthetic fixture)
rgba()/rgb() pattern captured only 'rgba(' — one exception blanket-suppressed every rgba in a file (SERIOUS)
Governance accepted an already-expired expiresAt into product_specific_exception (SERIOUS)
reviewers.reVerification: Re-ran all three counterexamples against the fixed build and stated 'All three fixes verified' before the agent was terminated early by a session usage limit; the final JSON verdict was not emitted. Each of the three fixes is additionally locked by regression tests that run in pnpm test (repo-system scanner-evasion suite; governance boundary tests).

mustFixFindings: Raw '-0.01em' shipped in .nas-brand and the scanner was blind to em/rem/unitless visual values (CRITICAL)
reviewers.reVerification: APPROVE (full JSON verdict). Live mutation test: injected letter-spacing/opacity/rem literals into base.css and confirmed 3 DS_RAW_VALUE findings, exit 1, clean revert; verified ThemeToggle now genuinely composes Button; verified all registry corrections, 193/193 tests, both gates green, working tree clean.

mustFixFindings: require()/createRequire smuggled an upward kernel→ui edge past every gate (CRITICAL)
Template-literal / string-concatenation raw values evaded the scanner (SERIOUS)
opacity/line-height unitless values invisible; live -0.01em shipped (SERIOUS)
Registry tests path at a nonexistent file passed the standalone gate (moderate, must-fix)
docs/definition-of-done.json stale '12 axe scans' count (moderate, must-fix)
reviewers.reVerification: Re-ran attacks 1-3 against the fixed build in an isolated worktree and confirmed each now caught (its progress notes record clean reverts), then was terminated early by a session usage limit before completing attack 4. Attack 4 was completed mechanically by the release process on the final build: pointing component tests at a nonexistent file and regenerating the artifact makes `node scripts/check-design-system.mjs` exit 1 with DS_BROKEN_REFERENCE per component (log: attack4-reverify). The stale DoD count fix (12→16) is verified in docs/definition-of-done.json.

outcome: All must-fix findings fixed in commit aa7c1f8 and re-verified against the final build; every previously evaded attack is now caught and regression-tested. Non-must-fix residuals are documented limitations (usesTokens accuracy is review-enforced; cycle enumeration is sound for existence but not exhaustive; computed values beyond the demonstrated idioms remain a disclosed static-analysis limit).
